title: Large deviations for mean field particle systems via analysis on spaces of measures
summary: This paper introduces a robust strategy to establish large deviation principles for mean field interacting particle systems in T d with vanishing noise. Viewed as a Freidlin-Wentzell type problem, our approach relies on recent techniques for partial differential equations (in short PDE) on the space of probability measures [5]. We first outline the proof strategy for the PDE approach to large deviations in a self-contained manner.
